subject: Hollisbridge SIG/CAIQ onboarding — scheduling & initial evidence cadence
messages:
From: Jake Morris <jake.morris@hollisbridge.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@hollisbridge.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Hollisbridge SIG/CAIQ intake — request for onboarding call

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for taking this — Hollisbridge would like to kick off a SIG/CAIQ intake for a potential deployment later this year. We have a short list of questions and would like to set a 45-minute intake call to cover: scope (hosted vs private), data residency, logging/retention requirements, and evidence handoff.

Can you propose 2–3 slots next week? Our security team (cc'd) will join, and Priya will handle procurement coordination.

Attached is our initial question bundle (Hollisbridge_SIG_Questions_v1.pdf). We'll also share an inventory of required artifacts after the call.

Notes: we prefer PDT mornings but can be flexible.

Thanks,
Jake Morris
Senior Security Engineer | Hollisbridge
security@hollisbridge.com

Attachment: Hollisbridge_SIG_Questions_v1.pdf (pdf, 42KB)
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Jake Morris <jake.morris@hollisbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hollisbridge SIG/CAIQ intake — request for onboarding call

Hi Jake — great to meet you (virtually). Thanks for sending the question set.

We can run a focused 45-minute intake and come prepared with an intake template and our typical evidence cadence. Proposed times (PDT):
- Tue 6/8 09:00–09:45
- Tue 6/8 11:00–11:45
- Wed 6/9 10:00–10:45

I'll attach our intake template and a high-level dataflow diagram so you can see the artifacts we'll request during the sprint. Marissa (our Security Onboarding Manager) will lead the runbook discussion; Ben (CS) will cover any environment access questions.

Pre-call asks:
- Can you confirm which deployment mode you're evaluating (hosted, dedicated, private)?
- A single point of contact for artifact uploads (SFTP/Drive)?
- Any blackout dates for your team next week?

If none of these slots work I'll send more options.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Technical Security Lead | Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-intake-template.xlsx (xlsx, 12KB); redwood-dataflow-diagram.png (png, 180KB)

--

Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2027 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hollisbridge SIG/CAIQ intake — request for onboarding call

Sofia,

Thanks — Tue 6/8 11:00–11:45 (PDT) works for our security folks. Confirming: we'll need a short agenda so we can loop in the right SMEs. A couple of clarifying questions ahead of the call:

1) Log retention: Hollisbridge retains audit and application logs for 13 months. Can you outline the typical artifacts you provide for retention and access (raw logs, aggregated metrics, retained KV cache excerpts, etc.)?
2) Evidence upload: do you prefer SFTP or shared Drive? If SFTP, can you provide instructions for an upload account?

Priya will handle procurement items post-call. Our security alias (security@hollisbridge.com) should receive the call invite.

Thanks,
Jake

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jake Morris <jake.morris@hollisbridge.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@hollisbridge.com>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2027 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Confirmed: SIG intake call Tue 6/8 11:00–11:45 PDT + pre-call notes

Hi Jake & Priya — thanks for confirming. I've scheduled the 45-minute intake for Tue 6/8 11:00–11:45 PDT and invited security@hollisbridge.com. Calendar invite: https://cal.example.com/meet/sofia-hollisbridge-0604

Agenda (30/15 split):
- 11:00–11:30: Scope & evidence cadence (Sofia) — deployment options, data residency, required artifacts
- 11:30–11:40: Access & technical questions (Ben) — SFTP/Drive, sample log exports, timestamps/retention specifics
- 11:40–11:45: Next steps & owners (Marissa)

Pre-call actions (owners, due Monday EOD):
- Hollisbridge: confirm deployment mode (hosted/dedicated/private) — Priya (priya.shah@hollisbridge.com)
- Hollisbridge: confirm preferred artifact upload method (SFTP or Drive) and provide contact for the upload account — Jake/Priya
- Redwood: send sample runbook for evidence sprint and SFTP upload instructions — Marissa (attached: srl_access_instructions.md)
- Redwood: provide a short list of the typical log artifacts we ask for (will bring to call) — Ben

I've attached the SRL (secure runbook) upload instructions and our intake template for your convenience. If you prefer Drive, we can send a secure folder link post-call.

Looking forward to the call.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Security Onboarding Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments: srl_access_instructions.md (text, 4KB); redwood-intake-template.xlsx (xlsx, 12KB)
